notes.title: Idle Medieval Tavern Joins the Idler Fest!
notes.content: Idle Medieval Tavern is proud to be part of this event, bringing the charm of medieval tavern management to the world of idle gaming. Set up your bustling alehouse, serve patrons, upgrade your establishment, and watch as your tavern thrives even while you're offline. Whether you're a hands-on innkeeper or prefer to let the gold roll in on its own, this Fest is the perfect time to dive in. Don’t miss out – join the fun and grow your medieval empire today!

notes.title: Strongblade is coming to Steam on September 14, 2023
notes.content:
Soon you can travel through a captivating world filled with puzzles, outsmart cunning villains, befriend charming animals, and build unique camps.

Strongblade is a vibrant, match-3 puzzle adventure with an irresistible charm. As Sean the Mouse, you'll navigate through a stunning world full of puzzles and obstacles, make friends with lovable animal characters, and outsmart crafty villains.

The game features over 30 distinct mechanics and thousands of levels, each packed with thrilling power-ups and combinations. Beyond just solving puzzles, you'll be exploring new territories, setting up and decorating unique campsites, and unearthing treasure chests filled with coins, power-ups, and boosters.

The excitement doesn't stop there. Strongblade lets you compete in heart-pounding in-game events against players from all over. With each level completed, you help brave Sean on his adventurous journey.

So dive into Strongblade's colorful world today. It's not just a game; it's a thrilling adventure filled with fun, challenges, and delightful surprises around every corner.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2430830/Strongblade__Puzzle_Quest_Match_3_and_Match3_Adventure_Puzzle/

notes.title: Bingo Beavers is Now Available!

notes.title: Hotfix Released
notes.content:
We have released a hotfix to address critical issues in the game:

- Fixed hero selection and purchase issues.
- Resolved reward retrieval problems for daily tasks.
- Improved the caravan panel for easier navigation.
- Added Chinese language.

notes.content: Embark on a thrilling journey with Idle Medieval Tavern, now available! As a medieval tavern owner, expand your business in this rich, immersive idle game. A captivating adventure awaits!
